priorities.title: Class feature runtime depth
priorities.reason: Twelve classes exist, but catalogue presence is not the same as every level feature being interactive in play mode.

priorities.title: Subclass feature runtime depth
priorities.reason: Subclass catalogue is broad; the next risk is placeholder summaries without executable resources, actions, reactions, saves or persistence.

priorities.title: Spell edge-case runtime
priorities.reason: Spell catalogue is large; summons, persistent zones, reactions, concentration and material-cost flows need playable parity rather than catalogue-only coverage.

priorities.title: Feat and item effect wiring
priorities.reason: Passive bonuses are useful, but action-granting feats and charged items must appear and persist in sheet/play flows.

priorities.title: Campaign-to-play loop
priorities.reason: Characters, encounters, rest, loot and journals exist; the remaining value is a continuous session loop with fewer manual jumps.

policy.rule: Every package after v5.129 must add a playable user-facing capability and include only targeted tests.
